SwitchPreference.android:title: Start at Boot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Off by default. Attempt DFRoot once per device boot using the selected SU manager.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Auto Soft Reboot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Off by default. Request a soft reboot after the launcher returns. Applies to manual and boot starts.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Disable KSU Modules
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Mark installed KSU modules disabled before each launch while enabled. Re-enable modules in your SU manager after recovery.
